candidate_selection.selection_rule: positive mean registered-partition prize uplift versus raw control in >=3 of 4 chronological 60-draw blocks; reject any block below half random baseline; rank by median uplift, lower-tail uplift, registered order

diversified_prize.ranking_definition: all legal tickets scored; top 4N score pool round-robin interleaved by blue and rarest-red coverage bucket
diversified_prize.stable_tie_break: red combination lexicographic ascending, then blue ascending
